verdict.comment: The new track is a question for FERROUS but the stiff test should suit and he gets the vote ahead of Germanic.

comments.aleezdancer: Very capable on turf; goes well fresh; shaky AW credentials; first run on sand since 2023
comments.badri: Acts well here; in good form since Southwell win in January; this may be too competitive
comments.bosh: Some good results on turf/AW for previous yard; well held in this last year; finding form
comments.cityhouse: Had profitable winter in Bahrain but now 19lb higher than latest AW defeat in November
comments.ferrous: One defeat from 5 handicap runs on AW; sterling effort at Southwell (6f) latest; up 4lb
comments.fivethousandtoone: Smart C&D win in March 2024 but not yet reached the same level for this yard
comments.germanic: Impressive in 7f novice here in 2024; ran well for long way on yard debut (6f); intriguing
comments.korker: Useful on turf but just two AW runs and down the field behind Ferrous at Southwell latest
comments.sergeantwilko: Won the second of two C&D runs but higher in the weights now and made low-key reappearance
comments.strikered: Two C&D wins earlier in career but needs improvement on AW runs and better form on turf
comments.telemark: Talented on his day but both handicap wins at 7f; 6f on AW debut is a new project
comments.thecaltonian: Five of six AW wins on this track, most recently in January, but high in weights now
comments.westmorian: Three 6f wins in March and April but went up 20lb and well held latest; left on same mark
comments.willemtwee: High class on Tapeta, including 3rd in C&D Group 3 last June but not quite firing now

races.raceComment: ferrous is marginally preferred with a score of 54.9%, holding clear edges in better ratings and better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over sergeantwilko. Won 2 of last 6 starts. Ground (Standard) looks ideal with 3 wins from 4 starts in similar conditions. Excellent course form of 6/17 at newcastle. Key attributes include optimal distance and positive comments, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.
